items.name: Milena J.
items.text_sr: Proces je bio jasan i brz. Dobila sam konkretan feedback trenera i brzo krenula sa casovima.
items.text_en: The process was clear and fast. I received direct trainer feedback and started teaching shortly after approval.

items.name: Nikola P.
items.text_sr: Fleksibilan raspored mi je pomogao da uskladim casove sa redovnim obavezama.
items.text_en: Flexible scheduling helped me combine classes with my full-time obligations. The support team was responsive during onboarding.

items.name: Ana S.
items.text_sr: Prijavila sam se tokom studija i izgradila stabilan mesecni raspored rada.
items.text_en: I joined while studying and built a stable monthly routine. The two-phase process set clear expectations from day one.
